## Download

| Your Mac | File |
| --- | --- |
| Apple chip (M1, M2, M3, M4) | `Gauntlet.Gamesmith-__VERSION__-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| Intel chip | `Gauntlet.Gamesmith-__VERSION__-mac-x64.dmg` |

Not sure which you have? Apple menu → **About This Mac**. If the chip line says
"Apple", take the arm64 file.

The `.zip` files hold the same app. Use them only if the `.dmg` gives you trouble.

**Mac only.** Windows and Linux builds are not produced yet.

__SIGNING_SECTION__

## What you need installed

- **Claude Code or Codex**, signed in with your own subscription. The app drives
  these tools; your subscription pays for the work. You do not have to install
  them yourself — the setup flow offers to do it for you.
- **Node.js** ([nodejs.org](https://nodejs.org/), the LTS version) — used to
  preview the games.
- **Git** — used to snapshot every round so you can go back.

Full setup instructions are in the [README](https://github.com/GlassBox-AI-Labs/gauntlet-gamesmith#readme).

## Notes

- Everything runs on your own machine. There is no account and no server. The app
  starts the sign-in for each coding tool and reads whether it worked; it never
  reads or stores your credentials.
- Dollar figures shown in the app are estimates of what the same work would cost
  through a pay-per-use API. They are not your bill.
